summary: auth set-token still accepts the token as an optional positional argument (with a stderr warning recommending stdin) so scripts written for earlier releases keep working.
reason: The 4.33.0 generator reads the token from stdin only (cobra.NoArgs), which breaks existing `hostex-pp-cli auth set-token <token>` scripts; stdin stays the documented form because it keeps the token out of process listings and shell history.
validated_outcome: TestSetTokenAcceptsLegacyPositionalToken and TestSetTokenStillReadsStdin run in an isolated home with a fake token; the token is never echoed.
